newsitem.title: USA: PCX to trade National Patent options.
newsitem.headline: PCX to trade National Patent options.

text.p: The Pacific Exchange (PCX) said Friday it will begin trading options on shares of National Patent Development Corp on August 6.
Opening strike prices have been set at 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. Initial expirations will be in September, October, December and March.
The options have been allocated to lead market makers Ron Goodman and Mark Weinstock, the exchange said.
National Patent shares were up 5/16 at 9-5/16 Friday afternoon.
